title: heart sticks
text: heart sticks. These are SO garbage... they arrived with 2 of the open hearts broken off the sticks.  The hearts are styrofoam like and you'd think you could restick them, but NOPE.  The sticks fall right out.  I put the remaining in a vase and even more fell off without even being touched!  I walked the vase over to the trash bin and dumped.  Very disappointed to say the least. I would certainly avoid buying these - just throw your money away and save time.  I rarely post super negative reviews, but this was frustrating to me.
